url.label: Immich URL
url.description: The address this server uses to reach Immich.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: Create one in Immich under Account Settings > API Keys, with the asset.read and asset.view permissions.

publicUrl.label: Public Immich URL
publicUrl.description: Optional. Links that open a photo in Immich use this address. Leave it blank to use the Immich URL above.
